axis.description: integer, tuple of integers, or ``None`` (all axes), representing the axes along which to standardize. Defaults to the last axis (``-1``).

mean.description: optionally specify the mean used for standardization. If not specified, then ``x.mean(axis, where=where)`` will be used.

variance.description: optionally specify the variance used for standardization. If not specified, then ``x.var(axis, where=where)`` will be used.

epsilon.description: correction factor added to variance to avoid division by zero; defaults to ``1E-5``.

where.description: optional boolean mask specifying which elements to use when computing the mean and variance.

output.description: An array of the same shape as ``x`` containing the standardized input.
